pageContext.name: MSc Computer Vision: Matching Anything by Segmenting Anything (MASA)
pageContext.description: Computer Vision course project in the MSc Data Science & Artificial Intelligence at Université Côte d'Azur. Study and re-implementation experiments around MASA (Matching Anything by Segmenting Anything, CVPR 2024) — learning instance-level correspondence / multi-object tracking from unlabeled images by leveraging the dense segmentation supervision of the Segment Anything Model.
